name: Nim
note: Python-inspired syntax compiled to native code via C
typeSystem: Static, strong, with powerful compile-time metaprogramming: generics, templates, and true AST-manipulating macros, wrapped in a Python-inspired significant-indentation syntax.
runtime: Compiles to native code by first generating C, C++, or JavaScript, then handing off to an existing backend compiler or toolchain.

runtimes.name: Native (via generated C)
runtimes.role: Default backend: Nim compiles to C, then a C compiler (GCC/Clang/MSVC) produces the native binary.

runtimes.name: Native (via generated C++)
runtimes.role: Alternative backend for easier interop with C++ libraries.

runtimes.name: JavaScript
runtimes.role: Compiles Nim to JavaScript for browser and Node.js targets.

compilers.name: nim c
compilers.role: Compiles Nim to C, then invokes a system C compiler to produce a native binary.

concurrencyModel: Deterministic memory management (ARC/ORC) with async/await built on a single-threaded event loop by default, plus opt-in OS threads and channels for true parallelism.
